name: pria-black-box
description: Pria Black Box — observability API for Pria answers. Reconstructs any Pria history turn as an auditable execution trace: answering twin, RAG/KAG evidence chunks + scores, confidentiality flags, optional reasoning telemetry, and live source-health warnings. Turns Pria's history flags + lazy RAG/KAG + thinking endpoints into a provenance instrument for agents.

config.description: Pria API base URL. Defaults to https://pria.praxislxp.com.
Pria API key (pria_<40 hex chars>). Prefer PRIA_API_KEY env var.
